connectorUiConfig.title: SecurityScorecard Cybersecurity Ratings
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [SecurityScorecard](https://securityscorecard.com) connector ingests daily cybersecurity ratings for all companies in a monitored portfolio into Microsoft Sentinel. SecurityScorecard rates organizations across ten risk factors—Network Security, DNS Health, Patching Cadence, Endpoint Security, IP Reputation, Application Security, Cubit Score, Hacker Chatter, Leaked Information, and Social Engineering—and produces an aggregate score (0–100) and letter grade. This connector polls your portfolio to discover member companies and then retrieves each company's score history on a daily cadence, enabling trend analysis, alerting on score drops, and third-party risk reporting inside Microsoft Sentinel.

graphQueries.baseQuery: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)

sampleQueries.description: All SecurityScorecard ratings from the last 24 hours
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| project TimeGenerated, Domain, Score
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

sampleQueries.description: Average daily score per domain (last 30 days)
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize AvgScore = avg(Score) by Domain
| sort by AvgScore asc

sampleQueries.description: Domains with score below 70 (at risk)
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize LatestScore = arg_max(TimeGenerated, Score) by Domain
| where Score < 70
| project Domain, Score
| sort by Score asc

sampleQueries.description: Score trend over the last 14 days by domain
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize AvgScore = avg(Score) by Domain, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by Domain asc, TimeGenerated asc

sampleQueries.description: Largest score drops in the last 7 days
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize
    EarliestScore = arg_min(TimeGenerated, Score),
    LatestScore = arg_max(TimeGenerated, Score)
    by Domain
| extend ScoreDrop = EarliestScore - LatestScore
| where ScoreDrop > 0
| project Domain, EarliestScore, LatestScore, ScoreDrop
| sort by ScoreDrop desc

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: The date for which the score was recorded, mapped from the 'date' field in the API response.

columns.name: Domain
columns.description: The company domain name for which the score history was retrieved (e.g. 'trueblue.com').

columns.name: Score
columns.description: The SecurityScorecard cybersecurity rating score for the company on the recorded date (0-100).

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Timestamp of the factor score entry, mapped from the 'date' field.

columns.name: Domain
columns.description: The company domain this factor score belongs to, mapped from 'domain'.

columns.name: Factors
columns.description: Array of factor scores. Each element has 'name' (e.g. 'network_security') and 'score' (0-100). Unpack at query time with mv-expand.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Timestamp of the event, mapped from the 'date' field.

columns.name: EventId
columns.description: Unique numeric identifier for the event, mapped from 'id'.

columns.name: Domain
columns.description: The company domain this issue belongs to, injected from the _domain placeholder.

columns.name: EventType
columns.description: Category of the event, mapped from 'event_type' (e.g. 'issues').

columns.name: GroupStatus
columns.description: Whether the issue is currently active or departed, mapped from 'group_status'.

columns.name: IssueCount
columns.description: Number of issues detected in this event, mapped from 'issue_count'.

columns.name: TotalScoreImpact
columns.description: Aggregate score impact of this event, mapped from 'total_score_impact'.

columns.name: IssueType
columns.description: Specific issue type identifier, mapped from 'issue_type' (e.g. 'tls_ocsp_stapling').

columns.name: Severity
columns.description: Severity level of the issue: info, low, medium, high, or critical.

columns.name: Factor
columns.description: Security factor category, mapped from 'factor' (e.g. 'network_security').

columns.name: DetailUrl
columns.description: URL linking to the full issue detail in the SecurityScorecard API, mapped from 'detail_url'.

connectorUiConfig.title: SecurityScorecard Issues (using Sentinel Connector Builder Agent)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The SecurityScorecard Issues connector ingests daily issue-change events from the [SecurityScorecard](https://securityscorecard.com) API into Microsoft Sentinel. For each company in the specified portfolio, it collects events from the `/companies/{domain}/history/events` endpoint — recording when issues appear, change severity, or resolve. Each row captures the issue type, severity, security factor, score impact, and resolution status, enabling continuous monitoring of your third-party attack surface.

Supports API Key authentication.

For more information, visit [SecurityScorecard API Docs](https://securityscorecard.readme.io/reference/introduction).

connectorUiConfig.title: SecurityScorecard Factor Scores
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The SecurityScorecard Factor Scores connector ingests daily per-factor security scores from the [SecurityScorecard](https://securityscorecard.com) API into Microsoft Sentinel. For each company in the specified portfolio, it collects scores across 10 security categories — DNS Health, IP Reputation, Network Security, Application Security, Patching Cadence, Endpoint Security, Social Engineering, Hacker Chatter, Leaked Information, and Cubit Score — from the `/companies/{domain}/history/factors/score` endpoint. Factor scores enable granular trend analysis and alerting on specific security weaknesses.

Supports API Key authentication.

For more information, visit [SecurityScorecard API Docs](https://securityscorecard.readme.io/reference/introduction).

graphQueries.baseQuery: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)

sampleQueries.description: All factor scores, most recent first
sampleQueries.query: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | sort by TimeGenerated desc

sampleQueries.description: Domains with weak network security (last 7 days)
sampleQueries.query: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | mv-expand factor = Factors | extend FactorName = tostring(factor.name), FactorScore = toint(factor.score) | where FactorName == "network_security" and FactorScore < 80 | project Domain, FactorScore | sort by FactorScore asc

sampleQueries.description: Factor score trends per domain (last 30 days)
sampleQueries.query: {{graphQueriesTableName}} | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | mv-expand factor = Factors | extend FactorName = tostring(factor.name), FactorScore = toint(factor.score) | summarize AvgScore = avg(FactorScore) by Domain, FactorName | sort by AvgScore asc

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The SecurityScorecard Cybersecurity Ratings V2 solution provides three Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) data connectors that ingest daily cybersecurity ratings data from the SecurityScorecard API into Microsoft Sentinel.

Connectors included:

  • SecurityScorecard Ratings — Daily overall score history for every company in a monitored portfolio (/companies/{domain}/history/score).
  • SecurityScorecard Issues — Daily security issue and event history, recording when issues appear, change severity, or resolve (/companies/{domain}/history/events).
  • SecurityScorecard Factor Scores — Daily per-factor scores across 10 security categories (DNS Health, IP Reputation, Network Security, Application Security, Patching Cadence, Endpoint Security, Social Engineering, Hacker Chatter, Leaked Information, Cubit Score) for every portfolio company (/companies/{domain}/history/factors/score).

All three connectors discover monitored companies automatically from a specified SecurityScorecard portfolio, requiring only an API key and portfolio ID at setup time.

Data Connectors: 3
